meaning: n. 輔修科目 adj. 不嚴重的；次要的
example: He suffered only minor injuries and was released from hospital the same day. (他只受了不嚴重的傷，當天就出院了。)

meaning: n. 政治學；政治；政治事務
example: She entered local politics after years of working for a community organisation. (她在社區組織工作多年後踏入政治。)
Economics helps explain why prices rise so sharply when demand outstrips supply. (經濟學有助於解釋需求超過供給時，價格為何會急遽上漲。)
The company now spends far more on marketing than on product development. (這家公司現在花在行銷上的錢遠多於產品開發。)
Good accounting practices help small businesses avoid tax problems and cash shortages. (良好的會計實務能幫助小企業避免稅務問題和現金短缺。)
Psychology has shown that people rarely make important decisions purely on logic. (心理學顯示，人們很少完全憑邏輯做重要決定。)
Modern biology relies on powerful microscopes and vast amounts of genetic data. (現代生物學仰賴強力顯微鏡和大量基因資料。)
Physics explains how energy moves between objects and why materials behave differently. (物理學解釋能量如何在物體間傳遞，以及材料為何有不同表現。)
Chemistry is essential to developing new medicines and much safer industrial processes. (化學對開發新藥和更安全的工業製程至關重要。)
The company improved its logistics, cutting delivery times from days to hours. (這家公司改善物流，把交貨時間從數天縮短到數小時。)
The geography of the region makes it difficult to build reliable transport links. (該地區的地形使建立可靠的交通連結十分困難。)
History shows that technological change often creates new jobs while destroying old ones. (歷史顯示，技術變革往往在消滅舊工作的同時創造新工作。)
Engineering graduates are in demand because the country is investing in infrastructure. (由於國家正投資基礎建設，工程學畢業生很搶手。)
The mechanics of the machine are simple, which makes repairs relatively easy. (這台機器的力學結構簡單，因此維修相對容易。)
Cheap electronics are often difficult to repair and quickly end up as waste. (便宜的電子器件往往難以維修，很快就變成垃圾。)
Many pupils struggle with maths because they fear making mistakes in class. (許多學生數學學不好，因為他們害怕在課堂上出錯。)
Calculus is used to model how populations and prices change over time. (微積分被用來模擬人口和價格如何隨時間變化。)
He paid a large sum for the flat before prices began to fall. (他在房價開始下跌前，為那間公寓付了一大筆錢。)

meaning: adj. 總的；全部的 n. 總數
example: The total cost of the project has risen by nearly thirty percent. (這個計畫的總成本已上漲將近三成。)
The merger of the two banks led to hundreds of job losses. (兩家銀行的併購導致數百人失業。)

meaning: prep. 減去 adj. 負的；零以下的
example: Ten minus four equals six, as the children learned in their maths class. (十減四等於六，這是孩子們在數學課學到的。)
She spent the remainder of the afternoon preparing carefully for the meeting. (她利用下午剩下的時間仔細準備會議。)

meaning: adj. 理性的；合理的 n. 有理數
example: A rational decision requires reliable information rather than a purely emotional reaction. (理性的決定需要可靠資訊，而非純粹的情緒反應。)

meaning: n. 參數；引數；限定因素
example: The researchers set clear parameters for the study to ensure consistent results. (研究人員為這項研究設定清楚的參數，以確保結果一致。)

meaning: n. 變數；可變因素 adj. 易變的
example: Rainfall is a key variable when predicting how well crops will grow. (降雨量是預測作物生長狀況的關鍵變數。)

meaning: adj. 均勻的；偶數的；相等的 adv. 甚至
example: The paint must be even, or the wall will look patchy in daylight. (油漆必須塗得均勻，否則牆面在白天看起來會斑駁。)

meaning: adj. 卑鄙的；吝嗇的 v. 意思是 n. 平均數；平均值
example: It was mean of him to criticise her work in front of everyone. (他當著大家的面批評她的作品，實在很卑鄙。)

meaning: adj. 兩倍的 n. 兩倍數；兩倍量 v. 使加倍
example: The council plans to double spending on cycle paths over the next five years. (議會計劃在未來五年把腳踏車道支出加倍。)

meaning: adj. 四倍的 n. 四倍 v. 成為四倍；使成四倍
example: House prices in the area have quadrupled since the new railway opened. (自新鐵路通車以來，該地區房價已漲為四倍。)
The table below compares the cost of living in five major cities. (下表比較五個主要城市的生活成本。)
The data were arranged in a matrix to make the patterns easier to see. (資料被排成矩陣，讓模式更容易看出來。)

meaning: adj. 斜紋的；對角線的 n. 對角線；斜紋織物
example: A diagonal path cuts across the square from the station to the market. (一條對角線步道穿過廣場，從車站通往市場。)

meaning: adj. 直的 adv. 筆直地；直接
example: Go straight along this road and turn left at the second traffic light. (沿著這條路直走，在第二個紅綠燈左轉。)

meaning: adj. 圓的 n. 一輪；繞圈 adv. 環繞
example: The committee held another round of talks to resolve the long-running dispute. (委員會舉行另一輪會談，以解決這場長期的爭議。)
Orange traffic cones marked the edge of the roadworks on the motorway. (橘色交通錐標出高速公路上施工範圍的邊界。)
The width of the bridge is too narrow for two buses to pass. (這座橋的寬度太窄，兩輛公車無法同時通過。)
The length of the waiting list has doubled since the clinic closed. (自診所關閉以來，候診名單的長度已增加一倍。)

meaning: adj. 小數的；十進位的 n. 小數
example: The answer should be given to two decimal places, as the instructions state. (依照指示，答案應寫到小數點後兩位。)
Nearly forty percent of local households now recycle food waste every week. (現在有近四成的當地家庭每週回收廚餘。)
The unemployment rate fell slightly last month, according to the latest official figures. (根據官方數據，上個月的失業率略為下降。)
The temperature reached ninety degrees Fahrenheit, which is unusually hot for April. (氣溫達到華氏九十度，對四月來說熱得不尋常。)

meaning: v. 煮沸 n. 沸點
example: Boil the water for at least a minute before adding the pasta. (水煮沸至少一分鐘後，再放入義大利麵。)

meaning: v. （使）生鏽 n. 鏽；鐵鏽
example: Salt air causes metal gates and railings to rust quickly near the coast. (海邊的鹽分空氣會讓金屬大門很快生鏽。)

meaning: v. （使）發酵；騷動 n. 酶；發酵；動亂
example: The mixture is left to ferment for several days before it is bottled. (混合物在裝瓶前會先放置數天發酵。)

meaning: v. 沖淡；稀釋 adj. 稀釋的；減弱的
example: Never dilute the cleaning product with water, or it will lose its effectiveness. (切勿用水稀釋清潔劑，否則會失去效力。)
The factory released noxious fumes that affected residents living several streets away. (工廠排放的有毒氣體影響到住在幾條街外的居民。)

meaning: adj. 無生氣的；惰性的；不活潑
example: Noble gases are largely inert and rarely react with other chemical substances. (惰性氣體大多不活躍，很少與其他化學物質反應。)
The doctrine of free trade has shaped national economic policy for decades. (自由貿易學說數十年來形塑了國家的經濟政策。)
The term 'carbon footprint' is now widely used in everyday conversation about climate. (「碳足跡」這個術語如今廣泛用於日常氣候對話中。)
The new timetable significantly reduces the number of late-night buses on weekdays. (新的時間表減少平日晚間公車的班次。)
The failure taught the company a costly lesson about testing products properly. (這次失敗給公司上了一堂昂貴的課：產品必須妥善測試。)
The syllabus has been revised to include more practical work and fewer exams. (教學大綱已修訂，納入更多實作課程與較少的考試。)
The public transport system is generally reliable, but fares have risen sharply. (大眾運輸系統很可靠，但票價已大幅上漲。)
Basic hygiene measures, such as regular hand washing, prevent many common infections. (基本的衛生措施，例如經常洗手，能預防許多常見感染。)
The course covers elementary statistics only, so no previous knowledge is required. (這門課教授初級統計，因此不需要先備知識。)
The university is highly selective and accepts only a small fraction of applicants. (這所大學篩選嚴格，只錄取極少部分的申請者。)

meaning: adj. 選修的；選擇性的 n. 選修課程
example: Students can choose an elective in journalism if they have spare credits. (學生如果還有剩餘學分，可以選修一門新聞課程。)

meaning: n. 預習；預告 v. 預習；預覽
example: The preview of the exhibition attracted more visitors than the organisers expected. (這場展覽的預告吸引的參觀者超出主辦單位預期。)
Auditors will scrutinise the company accounts before the annual report is published. (稽核人員會在年度報告公布前仔細檢查帳目。)
Children used to recite poems by heart in front of the whole class. (以前孩子們會在全班面前背誦詩歌。)

meaning: v. 讓（某人）聽寫；命令；強行規定
example: The manager dictated a letter to her assistant before leaving for the airport. (經理前往機場前，口述一封信讓助理聽寫。)
The final examination tests both written communication skills and practical problem solving. (期末考試同時測驗書面溝通和實際解決問題的能力。)

meaning: v. 測試；檢驗 n. 測試；檢驗
example: Engineers test the bridge every year to check for cracks and corrosion. (工程師每年測試這座橋，檢查是否有裂縫和腐蝕。)
The teacher ended the lesson with a short quiz on the new vocabulary. (老師以一個關於新單字的小測驗結束這堂課。)
University students who plagiarise the work of others face serious academic penalties. (抄襲他人作品的學生會面臨嚴重的學術懲處。)

meaning: n. 複製品；副本 v. 抄寫；複製
example: Please copy the full report to the finance department before Friday morning. (請在星期五早上前把報告複製一份給財務部門。)

meaning: v. 列印；印刷 n. 印刷品；照片
example: The new office printer can print double-sided pages to reduce paper use. (新印表機可以雙面列印，以減少紙張用量。)
Her paper on urban farming was published in a highly respected journal. (她關於都市農耕的論文發表在一份知名期刊上。)
Each section begins with a clear heading that tells readers what follows. (每個段落都以清楚的標題開始，告訴讀者接下來的內容。)
The risks were obvious from the outset, yet nobody raised serious objections. (這些風險從一開始就很明顯，卻沒有人提出嚴重反對。)
I missed the beginning, but the gist of his argument was clear. (我錯過開頭，但他論點的要點很清楚。)
Public opinion has shifted in favour of stricter rules on plastic waste. (民意已轉向支持對塑膠垃圾採取更嚴格的規定。)
The interview questions were carefully designed to elicit honest answers from workers. (面談問題的設計，是為了引出員工誠實的回答。)
I presume the meeting was cancelled because nobody has confirmed the time. (我猜想會議取消了，因為沒有人確認時間。)

meaning: v. 假定；假設 n. 假定；前提
example: The theory postulates that early childhood experience strongly shapes adult behaviour and health. (這個理論假定童年早期的經驗會強烈形塑成年後的行為。)
It was difficult to discern whether the figures included part-time or temporary workers. (很難辨別這些數字是否包含兼職或臨時工作者。)

meaning: v. 認識；辨認出；認可；承認
example: Employers increasingly recognise the value of good mental health support for staff. (雇主越來越能辨識出員工心理健康支持的重要性。)
His long silence seemed to imply that he disagreed with the proposal. (他的沉默似乎意味著他不同意這項提案。)
Few people fully understand how their personal data is collected and sold. (很少人完全理解自己的個人資料如何被蒐集和販售。)
It is hard to comprehend the scale of the damage without seeing it. (沒有親眼看到，很難理解損害的規模。)
Researchers analyse the water samples in order to identify traces of heavy metals. (研究人員分析水樣本，以找出重金屬的痕跡。)
The translation misses much of the nuance of the original, especially the humour. (這份翻譯漏掉原文的細微差別，尤其是幽默的部分。)
The inspection was extremely thorough, and every safety system was checked twice. (檢查很徹底，每一套安全系統都檢查了兩次。)
The teacher gave a simple example to show how the formula works. (老師舉了一個簡單的例子，說明這個公式如何運作。)

meaning: n. 例子；實例；情況；場合
example: In one instance, a faulty alarm delayed the evacuation by twenty minutes. (有一次，故障的警報器讓疏散延誤了二十分鐘。)
The results prove that early treatment greatly improves a patient's chances of survival. (結果證明，及早治療能大幅提高病患的存活機會。)
The council will decide next month whether to approve the new housing plan. (議會將在下個月決定是否核准新的住宅計畫。)
Recent research suggests that short naps can improve afternoon performance at work. (最近的研究顯示，短暫午睡能提升下午的工作表現。)
She phoned the hotel to inquire about parking, meals and breakfast times. (她打電話到飯店詢問停車、餐飲和早餐時間。)

meaning: n. 疑問；詢問 v. 詢問；懷疑
example: The bank replied to my query about the unexpected charge within a day. (銀行在一天內回覆我關於意外收費的詢問。)
The city hopes to achieve carbon neutrality by the middle of the century. (這座城市希望在本世紀中葉實現碳中和。)

meaning: n. 分數；標記 v. 標誌著；給……打分；做記號
example: The teacher will mark the essays over the weekend and return them on Monday. (老師會在週末批改作文，並在星期一發回。)

meaning: v. 給……分等級；評分 n. 等級；成績
example: The committee will grade each proposal on cost, safety and environmental impact. (委員會將依成本、安全和環境影響為每項提案評分。)
A row of empty shops has stood in the town centre for years. (市中心有一排空店面，已經閒置多年。)

meaning: n. 行列；佇列 v. 排隊等候
example: The queue for the ferry stretched along the road for nearly a kilometre. (等候渡船的隊伍沿著道路延伸將近一公里。)

meaning: n. 讚美；讚揚 v. 讚美；讚揚
example: The report deserves praise for its clear analysis of a complicated issue. (這份報告對複雜議題的分析清楚，值得讚揚。)
She was awarded a research fellowship to continue her work for three years. (她獲得研究獎學金，可以繼續研究工作三年。)

meaning: n. 獎賞；獎品 v. 珍視
example: The prize is awarded annually to a scientist under the age of forty. (這個獎項每年頒給四十歲以下的科學家。)
The entrance fee includes a guided tour of the castle and gardens. (門票費用包含城堡和花園的導覽。)
Digital technology has changed how people shop, bank and communicate with friends. (數位科技改變了人們購物、理財和與朋友溝通的方式。)

meaning: adj. 多種工藝的 n. 理工學院
example: He studied design at a local polytechnic before starting his own studio. (他在理工學院讀設計，之後創立自己的工作室。)
The engineer explained why the machine had failed and how to repair it. (工程師說明機器故障的原因以及如何修理。)
Companies must innovate continuously in order to remain competitive in global markets. (企業必須持續創新，才能在國際市場保持競爭力。)
The shop sells kitchen gizmos that promise to save time but rarely do. (這家店販售各種廚房小裝置，號稱能省時，卻很少有實際效果。)
Nobody knows who first invented the wheel, but it changed human history. (沒有人知道誰先發明了輪子，但它改變了人類歷史。)
Journalists uncovered evidence of illegal waste dumping near the river last year. (記者去年揭露了河邊非法傾倒廢棄物的證據。)

meaning: n. （活動或學問等的）領域；領土；領地
example: Artificial intelligence is no longer the exclusive domain of large technology firms. (人工智慧已不再是大科技公司的專屬領域。)
The clinic specialises in treating sports injuries and long-term back pain in adults. (這家診所專攻成人運動傷害與長期背痛的治療。)
The building utilises rainwater and solar power to reduce its running costs. (這棟建築利用雨水和太陽能來降低營運成本。)
Water usage in the city falls sharply during the cooler winter months. (這座城市在較涼爽的冬季月份用水量明顯下降。)
The tester reported several serious faults before the product reached the market. (測試員在產品上市前通報了幾項瑕疵。)
Translation tools are useful, but they cannot replace a skilled human translator. (翻譯工具很實用，但無法取代熟練的人類譯者。)

meaning: v. 測量；衡量 n. 措施；度量單位
example: The council has introduced several measures to reduce traffic near primary schools. (議會已推出幾項措施，以減少小學附近的交通量。)
The software can compute the likely cost of the project within seconds. (這套軟體能在幾秒內計算出這個計畫的可能成本。)
Every vote counts in a local election, even in apparently safe seats. (地方選舉中每一票都很重要，即使是在看似穩贏的選區。)
Cheaper flights are a welcome byproduct of intense competition between rival airlines. (機票變便宜是航空公司激烈競爭下受歡迎的副產品。)

meaning: adj. 輔助的；協助的；備用的
example: An auxiliary power unit keeps the hospital running during a sudden blackout. (備用電力設備讓醫院在突然停電時仍能運作。)
The new figures add to concerns that rents are rising faster than wages. (新數據增加了人們的憂慮：租金漲得比薪資快。)

meaning: v. 應在（某處）；適合（某種情形）
example: These old documents belong in the archive, not in the manager's office. (這些舊文件應該放在檔案室，而不是經理的辦公室。)
Recent advances in optics have made cameras smaller without reducing image quality. (光學的進步讓相機變得更小，卻不降低影像品質。)
The radar detected the storm early, giving residents valuable time to prepare. (雷達及早偵測到風暴，讓居民有時間準備。)

meaning: n. 回聲；共鳴 v. 發回聲；模仿；重複
example: The echo of the announcement could be heard across the empty hall. (公告的回聲在空蕩的大廳中迴盪。)
A sensor in the soil tells farmers exactly when the crops need water. (土壤中的感測器能確切告訴農民作物何時需要灌溉。)
The exhibition uses multimedia displays to explain the history of the city. (這個展覽用多媒體展示來解說這座城市的歷史。)
The rail network is being upgraded to cope with rising passenger numbers. (鐵路網正在升級，以因應不斷增加的乘客量。)
The latest version of the browser blocks most annoying pop-up advertisements by default. (最新版瀏覽器現在預設會阻擋大多數惱人的彈出式廣告。)

meaning: v. 撥（電話號碼） n. 撥號盤
example: She dialled the number twice, but nobody answered either time that morning. (她撥了兩次電話，但那天早上兩次都沒人接。)
The first microcomputers were slow and expensive, yet they changed office work. (最早的微電腦又慢又貴，卻改變了辦公室的工作方式。)
He works on a laptop during the train journey to save time. (他在搭火車時用筆記型電腦工作，以節省時間。)
The new software automatically checks long documents for spelling and grammar errors. (新軟體會自動檢查文件中的拼字和文法錯誤。)
A good keyboard reduces strain on the hands during long working days. (好的鍵盤能減少長時間工作時手部的負擔。)
The announcement came over the loudspeaker just as the train arrived at the platform. (火車進站時，廣播正好從揚聲器傳來。)
Please speak into the microphone so that everyone online can hear you. (請對著麥克風說話，讓線上所有人都能聽見。)
He sealed the box with tape before handing it to the courier. (他把箱子用膠帶封好，才交給快遞員。)

meaning: adj. 二進位制的；二元的
example: Computers store all information in binary form, using only zeros and ones. (電腦以二進位形式儲存資訊，只使用零和一。)
Wireless charging has made it easier to keep devices powered all day. (無線充電讓人更容易讓裝置全天保持電力。)

meaning: adj. 高解析度的；高畫質的

meaning: n. 銀；銀器 adj. 銀的；銀色的
example: The family keeps its silver in a locked cabinet and only uses it on special occasions. (這家人把銀器鎖在櫃子裡，只在特別場合才使用。)
This fine porcelain bowl was made in China during the eighteenth century. (這只精緻的瓷碗是十八世紀在中國製造的。)
She filled a bowl with hot soup and carried it carefully to the table. (她盛了一碗熱湯，小心地端到桌上。)
This dish is a local speciality made with rice, fish and coconut milk. (這道菜是當地特產，用米、魚和椰奶做成。)
He placed the cup on its saucer and asked for more tea. (他把杯子放回茶托上，又要求再添茶。)
The waiter carried a heavy tray of drinks through the crowded dining room. (服務生端著一大盤飲料，穿過擁擠的餐廳。)
Use a fork to turn the vegetables so that they cook evenly. (用餐叉翻動蔬菜，讓它們均勻受熱。)
The knife is too blunt to cut through the thick crust of the bread. (這把餐刀太鈍了，切不開厚厚的麵包皮。)
She stirred the hot soup with a wooden spoon and tasted it carefully. (她用木湯匙攪拌熱湯，小心地嚐了味道。)
He poured water into a tall glass and added a slice of lemon. (他把水倒進高玻璃杯，再加了一片檸檬。)
She keeps a large mug on her desk and refills it several times. (她桌上放著一個大馬克杯，一天續好幾次。)
The kettle boiled, and she poured the hot water over the tea leaves. (水壺煮開了，她把熱水倒在茶葉上。)
Heat a little oil in a large pan and add the chopped onions. (在大平底鍋裡加熱一點油，然後放入切碎的洋蔥。)
She left the pot on the stove and went to answer the phone. (她把鍋子留在爐子上，去接電話。)
The bread needs about twenty minutes in a hot oven to become golden. (麵包需要在熱烤箱裡烤約二十分鐘才會呈金黃色。)
He opened a tin of tomatoes and added them to the sauce. (他打開一罐番茄罐頭，倒進醬汁裡。)
Put the lid on the pot so that the rice cooks more quickly. (把蓋子蓋在鍋上，這樣飯會熟得比較快。)

meaning: v. 喝；飲酒 n. 飲料
example: You should drink plenty of water during long flights to avoid headaches. (長途飛行時應該多喝水，以免頭痛。)
The children drank fresh orange juice with breakfast before leaving for school. (孩子們早餐喝了現榨柳橙汁，然後才出門上學。)
He mixed soda water with lime juice and served it over crushed ice. (他把蘇打水混入萊姆汁，加碎冰端上桌。)
She drinks strong black coffee every morning but avoids it after lunch. (她每天早上喝濃黑咖啡，但午餐後就不喝了。)
The old man poured a little whisky into a glass and sat down. (那位老先生倒了一點威士忌到杯子裡，然後坐下。)
A small glass of brandy warmed him after the walk in the rain. (在雨中走了一段路後，一小杯白蘭地讓他暖和起來。)
The driver was arrested because he was clearly drunk at the wheel. (那名駕駛因為明顯酒醉開車而被逮捕。)
The government has increased tax on tobacco to discourage young people from smoking. (政府提高菸草稅，以勸阻年輕人吸菸。)
He stepped outside to smoke a cigarette before the long meeting resumed. (漫長的會議繼續前，他走到外面抽了一根香菸。)

meaning: adj. 清醒的；未醉的 v. （使）醒酒
example: After a night's sleep he was sober enough to drive home safely. (睡了一夜後，他已經清醒到可以安全開車回家。)
The soup contains several kinds of fresh vegetable, including carrots and cabbage. (這道湯含有多種新鮮蔬菜，包括胡蘿蔔和高麗菜。)
The tomato plants in the garden need support as the fruit becomes heavy. (花園裡的番茄植株在果實變重時需要支架。)
She boiled the potatoes and mashed them with butter and a little milk. (她把馬鈴薯煮熟，加上奶油和一點牛奶搗成泥。)
Frozen peas are convenient because they keep their sweetness for many months. (冷凍豌豆很方便，因為它們能保持甜味好幾個月。)
These dried beans need to soak overnight before they can be cooked. (這些乾豆類需要泡一夜才能煮。)
The market sells fresh cabbage, which is often used in local soups. (市場賣新鮮高麗菜，當地人常拿來煮湯。)
Chop the onion finely, then fry it until it turns soft and golden. (把洋蔥切碎，然後炒到變軟、呈金黃色。)
She roasted the eggplant with olive oil, garlic and a little salt. (她把茄子加橄欖油、大蒜和少許鹽一起烤。)
A carrot is easy to grow and is rich in several important vitamins. (胡蘿蔔容易種植，而且富含多種重要維生素。)
The farmer pulled a large turnip from the soil and showed it to us. (農夫從土裡拔出一顆大蕪菁，拿給我們看。)
Add a few sliced radishes to the salad for colour and crunch. (在沙拉裡加幾片小蘿蔔，增添色彩和脆度。)

meaning: v. 剝皮；削皮；脫落 n. 果皮
example: Peel the apples before cooking them, then cut them into small pieces. (蘋果煮之前先削皮，然後切成小塊。)

meaning: n. 外殼；船體 v. 剝去外殼
example: Farmers hull the rice after harvest to remove the dry outer layer. (農民在收成後把稻穀去殼，除去乾燥的外層。)
Each berry is picked by hand, so the work is slow and expensive. (每顆莓果都是人工採摘，因此這項工作既慢又花錢。)
The grapes are harvested in late summer and pressed for fresh juice. (葡萄在夏末採收，壓榨成新鮮果汁。)
A ripe papaya is sweet and soft, and it is rich in vitamin A. (成熟的木瓜香甜柔軟，而且富含維生素A。)
The peaches from this orchard are sold at the market every morning. (這座果園的水蜜桃每天早上在市場販售。)
A single pear tree in the garden produces more fruit than we need. (花園裡一棵梨子樹結的果實就比我們需要的還多。)
She made jam from plums that had fallen from the old tree. (她用老樹上掉下來的李子做果醬。)
He cut an orange into quarters and shared it with his sister. (他把一顆柳橙切成四份，和妹妹一起分著吃。)
The melon was so ripe that it split when he touched it. (那顆甜瓜熟到他一碰就裂開了。)
Add a slice of lemon to the water to give it more flavour. (在水裡加一片檸檬，讓味道更豐富。)
A kiwi contains more vitamin C than an orange of the same weight. (同樣重量下，奇異果的維生素C含量比柳橙高。)
The rice crop failed that year because the rains came far too late. (那年稻作歉收，因為雨季來得太晚。)
Corn grows well in this region, where summers are long and hot. (這個地區夏季漫長炎熱，玉米長得很好。)
Whole grain bread contains more fibre than bread made from white flour. (全穀麵包的纖維含量比白麵粉做的麵包高。)
Wheat is the main crop in this area and is used for flour. (小麥是這個地區的主要作物，用來製成麵粉。)
Farmers reap the wheat in August, when the fields are dry and golden. (農民在八月收割小麥，那時田野乾燥且一片金黃。)
The flour is stored in a cool, dry place to keep it fresh. (麵粉存放在陰涼乾燥的地方，以保持新鮮。)
He eats warm porridge with honey and fruit every morning before work. (他每天早上上班前都吃加蜂蜜和水果的熱麥片粥。)
Mix the flour with water to make a thick paste for the pie. (把麵粉和水混合成濃稠的糊，用來做派。)
The chicken was roasted with fresh herbs and served with steamed rice. (雞肉和新鮮香草一起烤，搭配白飯上桌。)
In some countries, turkey is served at family meals on special holidays. (在某些國家，特別節日的家庭聚餐會吃火雞肉。)
The beef needs to cook slowly for several hours so that it becomes tender. (牛肉需要慢煮好幾個小時才會變嫩。)
Pork must be cooked thoroughly to reduce the risk of food-related illness. (豬肉必須徹底煮熟，以降低食物引起疾病的風險。)
The stew is made with mutton and root vegetables and cooked for hours. (這道燉菜用羊肉和根莖類蔬菜煮了好幾個小時。)

meaning: n. 魚；魚肉 v. 釣魚；捕魚
example: Local fishermen catch enough fish to supply the small restaurants along the coast. (當地漁民捕的魚足以供應沿海的小餐館。)
The village pond freezes every winter, and children skate on the ice. (村裡的池塘每年冬天結冰，孩子們就在冰上滑冰。)
He repaired his old fishing rod before the trip to the lake. (去湖邊釣魚前，他修好了那根舊釣竿。)

meaning: n. 奶；牛奶 v. 擠奶
example: The farm sells fresh milk to nearby shops and to local families. (這座農場把新鮮牛奶賣給附近商店和當地家庭。)
She eats plain yogurt with berries and nuts for breakfast most mornings. (她大多數早上都吃原味優格配莓果和堅果當早餐。)
He added a spoonful of cream to the soup to make it richer. (他在湯裡加了一匙鮮奶油，讓味道更濃郁。)
This cheese is aged for a year and has a strong, salty flavour. (這款起司熟成一年，味道濃郁且帶鹹味。)

meaning: n. 奶油；黃油 v. 塗奶油
example: Melt a little butter in the hot pan before adding the beaten eggs. (在熱鍋裡融化一點奶油，再倒入打散的蛋液。)
The salad is made with ripe tomatoes, cucumber, olives and a lemon dressing. (這道沙拉用熟番茄、小黃瓜、橄欖和檸檬醬汁做成。)

meaning: n. 三明治 v. 把……夾入
example: He made a sandwich with cheese and ham and wrapped it for lunch. (他做了起司火腿三明治，包起來當午餐。)
The café serves a huge hamburger with fries and a cold drink. (這家小館供應超大漢堡，附薯條和冷飲。)

meaning: n. 一條（麵包） v. 遊蕩；閒逛
example: She baked a loaf of bread and left it to cool on the table. (她烤了一條麵包，放在桌上放涼。)
The apple pie was still warm when we cut it into slices. (我們把蘋果派切成片時，它還是溫熱的。)
We ordered a large pizza and shared it on the balcony at sunset. (我們點了一個大披薩，日落時在陽台一起分著吃。)

meaning: n. 義大利麵食；義大利麵
example: The pasta is served with a simple sauce of tomatoes and basil. (這道義大利麵搭配簡單的番茄羅勒醬汁。)
He twirled the long spaghetti around his fork and ate it quickly. (他把長長的義大利細麵捲在叉子上，很快吃完。)
The soup is thick and warming, perfect for a cold winter evening. (這道湯濃郁又暖身，非常適合寒冷的冬夜。)

meaning: n. （英）餅乾；（美）烤餅；小圓麵包
example: She offered us tea and homemade biscuits while we waited for the bus. (我們等公車時，她端出茶和自製餅乾招待我們。)
The jam is made from strawberries grown in the garden each summer. (這個果醬是用每年夏天花園裡種的草莓做的。)
Check the ingredients carefully in case the cake contains traces of nuts. (仔細檢查成分，以免蛋糕含有堅果的痕跡。)
He gave her a small box of dark chocolate for Valentine's Day. (情人節時，他送她一小盒黑巧克力。)
The children bought ice cream from a van parked near the beach. (孩子們向停在海灘附近的餐車買冰淇淋。)

meaning: n. 香草 adj. 香草味的
example: The cake is flavoured with vanilla and topped with fresh summer berries. (這個蛋糕以香草調味，上面鋪著新鮮夏季莓果。)
He spread mustard on the sandwich and added a slice of cheese. (他在三明治上抹芥末，再加一片起司。)
The sushi is served with wasabi and soy sauce on the side. (壽司旁邊附上山葵和醬油。)
Add a slice of fresh ginger to the tea to soothe a sore throat. (在茶裡加一片新鮮的薑，可以舒緩喉嚨痛。)
The recipe calls for two cloves of garlic and a large onion. (這個食譜需要兩瓣大蒜和一顆大洋蔥。)
Chop the fresh scallion and sprinkle it over the noodles before serving. (把新鮮青蔥切碎，上桌前撒在麵上。)
A little vinegar and oil makes a simple dressing for the salad. (一點醋和油就能做成簡單的沙拉醬。)
Too much salt in the diet can raise blood pressure over time. (飲食中鹽分過高，長期下來可能使血壓上升。)
The recipe uses less sugar than the original version but tastes just as good. (這份食譜的糖比原版少，但味道一樣好。)
The child spent her pocket money on candy at the corner shop. (這孩子把零用錢花在轉角雜貨店的糖果上。)
Local honey is sold in glass jars at the weekend farmers' market. (當地蜂蜜在週末農夫市集以玻璃罐販售。)

meaning: n. 味道；口味；特色；風格
example: The flavour of the soup improves when it is left overnight in the fridge. (這道湯在冰箱放一夜後，味道會更好。)
The milk has turned sour, so we must throw the whole bottle away. (牛奶已經酸掉了，我們得把整瓶丟掉。)
The local oranges are so sweet that they need no added sugar. (當地柳橙甜到不需要再加糖。)

meaning: adj. 苦的；痛苦的；嚴寒的
example: The coffee is too bitter, so he adds a little milk and sugar. (這咖啡太苦了，所以他加了一點牛奶和糖。)
This curry is far too spicy for my young nephew to eat comfortably. (這道咖哩對我年幼的姪子來說太辣，很難吃得舒服。)
The roasted vegetables were absolutely delicious, and everyone asked for the recipe. (烤蔬菜非常美味，每個人都要食譜。)
The children declared the cake yummy and asked for a second piece. (孩子們說蛋糕很好吃，還要求再來一塊。)
The soup was simple but tasty, made with vegetables from the garden. (這道湯簡單卻可口，是用花園裡的蔬菜煮的。)
The charity provides meals for children who suffer from hunger during holidays. (這個慈善機構在假期間為飽受飢餓之苦的孩子提供餐食。)
The sauce is made from tomatoes, garlic and a little red wine. (這個醬汁用番茄、大蒜和少許紅酒做成。)
He put ketchup on his chips, although the waiter clearly disapproved of it. (他在薯條上擠番茄醬，雖然服務生明顯不以為然。)
The scent of her perfume lingered in the room long after she left. (她離開很久後，房間裡仍留著她的香水味。)

meaning: v. 烹調；煮 n. 廚師
example: My father taught me to cook simple meals when I was ten. (我十歲時，父親教我煮簡單的飯菜。)
She plans to bake bread and small cakes for the school fair. (她打算為學校園遊會烤麵包和小蛋糕。)
Fry the fish in hot oil for a few minutes on each side. (把魚放進熱油裡，兩面各煎幾分鐘。)

meaning: v. 向……祝酒；烤 n. 烤麵包片；吐司
example: The guests raised their glasses to toast the happy young couple warmly. (賓客舉杯，熱烈向這對幸福的新人祝酒。)
The baby sucked milk from the bottle and soon fell asleep in her arms. (嬰兒從奶瓶吮吸牛奶，很快就在她懷裡睡著了。)
The dog licked the plate clean and then looked up at us hopefully. (狗把盤子舔得乾乾淨淨，然後充滿期待地抬頭看我們。)
He chewed gum during the long flight to stop his ears from hurting. (他在長途飛行時嚼口香糖，以免耳朵疼痛。)
She dipped a piece of bread into the soup and tasted it. (她把一塊麵包蘸進湯裡，然後嚐了一口。)
The erection of the new library took eighteen months and cost several million pounds. (新圖書館的建造花了十八個月，耗資數百萬英鎊。)
The council plans to build affordable housing on the empty site near the station. (市議會計劃在車站附近的空地上建造平價住宅。)
The school was founded in 1892 by a group of local farmers. (這所學校由一群當地農民於一八九二年創辦。)
The bridge is made of steel and can carry very heavy trucks safely. (這座橋是鋼鐵打造的，能安全承受極重的卡車。)
The stability of the old wall was weakened by years of rain. (這道老牆的穩定性因長年雨水而減弱。)
Building work on the site stopped after workers found ancient stone remains. (工人在工地發現古代石造遺跡後，工程就停工了。)
Several rare birds reside on the small island throughout the winter months. (幾種稀有鳥類整個冬天都棲息在這座小島上。)
Few animals can inhabit this desert because water is so scarce there. (很少動物能棲息在這片沙漠，因為當地水資源極為稀少。)
The old stone dwelling had no running water and only one small window. (這棟老石屋沒有自來水，而且只有一扇小窗戶。)
They rented a villa with a small pool for two weeks in summer. (他們夏天租了一棟附小泳池的度假別墅，住了兩週。)
Her apartment is small but bright, and the monthly rent is quite reasonable. (她的公寓不大但採光好，月租也相當合理。)

meaning: v. 租住；寄宿 n. 小屋；度假屋
example: Students often lodge in a small guesthouse near the station during term time. (學生在學期間常寄宿在車站附近的一間小旅館。)
The shepherd slept in a small wooden hut on the hillside during summer. (牧羊人夏天睡在山坡上一間小木屋裡。)

meaning: n. 小木屋；（船上的）小艙
example: We stayed in a simple log cabin beside the lake for three nights. (我們在湖邊一間簡樸的小木屋住了三晚。)
The wine is kept in a cool stone cellar beneath the old house. (葡萄酒存放在老屋下方的涼爽石造地窖裡。)

meaning: n. 棚屋；小屋 v. 流；灑；擺脫
example: He keeps his garden tools and bicycle in a shed behind the kitchen. (他把園藝工具和腳踏車放在廚房後面的棚屋裡。)
The old cottage has low ceilings and a fire in almost every room. (這棟老村舍天花板很低，幾乎每個房間都有壁爐。)
This small region is often called the cradle of modern European democracy. (這個小地區常被稱為現代歐洲民主的發源地。)
We sat on the porch and watched the storm move across the valley. (我們坐在門廊上，看著暴風雨掃過山谷。)
She carried the heavy box up the stairs to the second floor. (她把沉重的箱子搬上樓梯到二樓。)
The building has five storeys, and the top floor is a restaurant. (這棟建築有五個樓層，頂樓是一家餐廳。)
The elevator stopped between two floors, and we waited twenty minutes for help. (電梯卡在兩個樓層之間，我們等了二十分鐘才有人來協助。)
Hold the handrail when you go down the steps, especially when they are wet. (下階梯時請扶著扶手，尤其是階梯溼滑的時候。)
A thick stone pillar supports the heavy roof of the main entrance hall. (一根粗石柱支撐著主入口大廳的沉重屋頂。)
The bank keeps its gold in a secure underground vault beneath the building. (銀行把黃金存放在建築物下方安全的地下金庫。)

meaning: n. 拱門 v. （使）彎成弓形
example: The arch of the old bridge has stood for more than six centuries. (這座老橋的拱門已經屹立超過六百年。)
The ceiling is so low that tall visitors must bend their heads. (天花板很低，高個子的訪客必須低頭。)
Rain dripped steadily from the eaves onto the wet path below the window. (雨水從屋簷不斷滴到窗下溼滑的小路上。)
Thin smoke rose from the chimney and disappeared into the cold grey sky. (淡淡的煙從煙囪升起，消失在寒冷的灰空中。)
An old man sat on a bench and fed the pigeons in the square. (一位老人坐在長凳上，在廣場餵鴿子。)
The family gathered in the parlour after dinner to listen to the radio. (晚餐後，一家人聚在客廳聽收音機。)
A bright fire burned in the fireplace, filling the small room with warmth. (壁爐裡燃著明亮的火，讓小房間充滿暖意。)
The old radiator under the window makes a loud knocking sound at night. (窗下那台老暖氣裝置夜裡會發出很大的敲擊聲。)
The living room opens onto a small garden through two wide glass doors. (客廳透過兩扇寬大的玻璃門通向一座小花園。)
The medicine is kept in a locked cabinet at the back of the clinic. (藥品放在診所後方一個上鎖的儲藏櫃裡。)
The kitchen is narrow, but it has a large window and plenty of light. (廚房很窄，但有一扇大窗戶，採光充足。)

The two sides finally reached an agreement on the sharing of water resources. (雙方終於就水資源分配達成協議。)
The new protocol sets out how data should be stored and shared between hospitals. (新的協定書規定了醫院之間應如何儲存和分享資料。)

meaning: n. 標準；規範；行為準則
example: Working from home has become the norm in many skilled professional occupations across the country. (在全國許多專業技術職業中，在家工作已成為常態。)
The test provides a national benchmark against which schools can measure their progress. (這項測驗提供全國基準，讓各校衡量自身的進步。)

meaning: n. 標準；準則（criterion 的複數）
example: Applicants must meet several strict criteria, including relevant experience and two good references. (申請者必須符合幾項嚴格標準，包括相關經驗和兩封良好的推薦信。)
The museum rules allow visitors to take photographs but not to use flash. (博物館規定允許訪客拍照，但不得使用閃光燈。)

meaning: n. 違約；預設值 v. 不履行；違約
example: The borrower defaulted on the loan after losing his job at the plant last year. (這名借款人去年在工廠失業後，就無力償還貸款而違約。)
Lack of time and money are the two main constraints on the research team. (時間和經費不足是研究團隊面臨的兩大限制。)
The official report will be published only after the election is completely over. (官方報告要等選舉完全結束後才會公布。)
Wearing a helmet is mandatory for everyone on large construction sites in the country. (在這個國家的大型建築工地，每個人都必須戴安全帽。)

meaning: adj. 很有效的；強有力的
example: The drug is very potent, so patients must take it only in small doses. (這種藥很有效，所以病患只能服用小劑量。)
The high court will hear the complex case again in early September this year. (高等法院將在今年九月初再次審理這起複雜案件。)
The Supreme Court ruled that the police search had been unlawful from the start. (最高法院裁定，警方的搜索從一開始就不合法。)
Parliament has legislated to limit the amount of added sugar in school meals nationwide. (國會已立法限制全國學校餐點的添加糖用量。)

meaning: adj. 公正的；正義的 adv. 剛剛；僅僅
example: The judge tried to reach a just decision after hearing both sides argue at length. (法官在聽取雙方長時間辯論後，設法做出公正的判決。)
Prejudice often prevents employers from judging job candidates purely on their actual ability and experience. (偏見常讓雇主無法單純依據求職者實際的能力和經驗來評判他們。)
The law protects workers against discrimination on the grounds of age, sex or disability. (法律保障勞工不因年齡、性別或身心障礙而受到歧視。)
The local newspaper accused the company of deliberately hiding evidence about the fatal river accident. (當地報紙指責該公司刻意隱匿那起致命河川事故的證據。)

meaning: v. 控告；提起訴訟；請求
example: The residents plan to sue the factory over years of pollution in the river. (居民計劃就多年河川污染問題控告這家工廠。)
The authorities finally decided to prosecute the factory owner for repeatedly ignoring basic safety regulations. (當局終於決定起訴這名工廠老闆，因為他屢次漠視基本安全法規。)

meaning: n. 抵制；拒絕購買 v. 抵制
example: Local shoppers threatened to boycott the supermarket unless it stopped using thin plastic bags. (當地消費者揚言，除非超市停用薄塑膠袋，否則就要抵制。)
A neutral official was invited to mediate between the two sides in the dispute. (一位中立官員受邀在爭議雙方之間調解。)

meaning: n. 辯解理由；藉口；請求
example: His plea that he had acted in self-defence did not convince the jury. (他辯稱自己是出於自衛，但陪審團並不採信。)

meaning: v. 低聲低語；小聲抱怨
example: She muttered something about the constant traffic noise and firmly closed the window. (她低聲抱怨著持續的交通噪音，然後用力關上窗戶。)

meaning: n. 低語；咕噥 v. 低聲說；咕噥
example: A low murmur of agreement spread through the crowd after the mayor's short speech. (市長簡短演說後，群眾間傳開一片低聲的贊同。)

meaning: adj. 沉默的；寂靜無聲的
example: The whole room fell silent when the manager entered with the final results. (經理帶著最終結果走進來時，整個房間一片沉默。)

meaning: adj. 緘默的；啞的；無聲的 n. 啞巴
example: He remained mute throughout the interview and refused to answer any of the questions. (整場面談他都保持緘默，拒絕回答任何問題。)

meaning: n. 法官；裁判員 v. 判斷；審判
example: The judge reminded the jury to consider only the evidence presented in open court. (法官提醒陪審團只能考慮在公開法庭上提出的證據。)

meaning: n. 陪審團；評判委員會
example: The jury took two full days to reach a unanimous verdict of not guilty. (陪審團花了整整兩天才達成無罪的一致裁決。)

meaning: n. 句子；判決 v. 宣判；判刑
example: The judge finally sentenced him to three years in prison for large-scale fraud. (法官最後判他三年徒刑，罪名是大規模詐欺。)

meaning: v. 逮捕；吸引（注意） n. 逮捕
example: Police arrested two young men near the station shortly after the armed bank robbery. (武裝搶銀行案發生後不久，警方就在車站附近逮捕兩名年輕男子。)

meaning: n. 監獄 v. 監禁
example: He spent six months in jail last year for repeatedly driving without valid insurance. (他去年因多次無有效保險開車，在監獄待了六個月。)
The old prison is badly overcrowded, with two inmates sharing most of the cells. (這座老監獄嚴重超收，大多數牢房都關了兩名囚犯。)

meaning: n. 罪；罪孽 v. 犯罪；犯戒律
example: In many religious traditions, deliberately telling a lie is considered a serious sin. (在許多宗教傳統中，刻意說謊被視為嚴重的罪。)
Gambling was once regarded as a vice rather than a form of entertainment. (賭博曾被視為一種惡行，而不是娛樂方式。)

meaning: n. 賄賂；賄款 v. 行賄
example: The senior official was arrested for accepting a bribe from a local building company. (這名高階官員因收受當地一家建築公司的賄賂而被捕。)
Two men robbed the small village post office and escaped on a motorbike. (兩名男子搶劫了村裡的小郵局，然後騎機車逃逸。)
It is surprisingly easy to steal a bicycle left outside the library. (把停在圖書館外的腳踏車偷走，竟然出乎意料地容易。)
The thief was caught on camera entering the building through a window. (監視器拍到這名竊賊從窗戶進入建築物。)
The charity runs a free telephone helpline for people at risk of suicide. (這個慈善機構為有自殺風險的人提供免費電話求助專線。)
Nobody in the office trusts him because he has proved to be a habitual liar. (辦公室裡沒有人相信他，因為他已證明自己是慣性說謊的人。)

meaning: n. 蠢人；傻子 v. 欺騙；愚弄
example: I felt like a fool when I realised I had left the tickets at home. (我發現把票忘在家裡時，覺得自己像個傻子。)
There is still a strong social stigma attached to mental illness in many workplaces. (在許多職場，心理疾病仍背負著強烈的社會汙名。)
The suspect finally confessed to taking the missing money from the office safe. (嫌犯終於供認從辦公室保險箱拿走了失竊的錢。)
The two brothers finally reconciled with each other after almost ten years of bitter silence. (兩兄弟在將近十年的痛苦沉默後，終於彼此和解。)
Drivers must obey the speed limit even on quiet country roads at night. (即使在夜間安靜的鄉間道路，駕駛也必須遵守速限。)

meaning: n. 罰款 adj. 美好的；很好的 v. 處以罰款
example: The company was fined heavily for dumping untreated waste into the local river. (這家公司因把未處理廢棄物排入當地河川而被重罰。)

meaning: n. 房貸；抵押貸款 v. 抵押
example: They took out a mortgage to buy a small house near the school. (他們申請房貸，買了一棟學校附近的小房子。)
Ownership of the disputed land was finally transferred to the local community in 1998. (這塊爭議土地的所有權終於在一九九八年移轉給當地社區。)
The copyright for all these photographs belongs to the photographer, not the magazine. (這些照片的版權屬於攝影師，而不是雜誌社。)
The large donation was anonymous, so the school could not even thank the donor. (這筆大額捐款是匿名的，學校甚至無法向捐款人道謝。)

meaning: adj. 不正確的；虛假的；偽造的
example: The article was based on completely false information and had to be corrected. (這篇文章根據完全錯誤的資訊寫成，必須更正。)

meaning: n. 請願書；上訴 v. 請求；請願
example: More than ten thousand local residents signed the petition against the new road. (一萬多名當地居民簽署請願書，反對興建這條新路。)

meaning: v. 命令；指揮 n. 命令；指揮；控制；運用能力
example: The officer gave a quiet command, and the soldiers moved forward at once. (軍官輕聲下了一道命令，士兵立刻向前移動。)

meaning: n. 突襲；突然搜查 v. 突襲
example: Police raided the warehouse early this morning and found thousands of counterfeit handbags inside. (警方今天清晨突襲倉庫，在裡面查獲數千個仿冒名牌包。)
She did not fully understand the enormity of the decision until several years later. (直到好幾年後，她才完全理解這個決定有多重大。)

meaning: n. 戰鬥；戰役 v. 與……戰鬥
example: The long battle for control of the coastal city lasted almost three weeks. (爭奪這座沿海城市控制權的漫長戰役持續了將近三週。)

meaning: v. 掙扎；奮鬥 n. 掙扎；奮鬥
example: Many low-income families struggle to pay their rent and heating bills in winter. (許多低收入家庭在冬天苦苦掙扎，才能付得出房租和暖氣費。)
